notes: Verified against catalog.ucsd.edu/curric/DSC-ug.html and datascience.ucsd.edu/current-students/major-requirements/. Major totals 112 units: 52 lower-division + 60 upper-division. Offered by the Halicioglu Data Science Institute (HDSI). Courses with '/R' suffixes (e.g., DSC 10R) are equivalent remote-section versions. One correction from harvest: the EDA/statistics requirement is 'MATH 189 or DSC 152' (choose one), not MATH 189 alone. All other buckets corroborated. Prerequisites for all courses must be satisfied.

buckets.label: Data Science lower-division core
buckets.note: All seven required (28 units). DSC 10/20/30/40A/40B/80 also have equivalent '/R' versions.

buckets.label: Subject domain two-course sequence
buckets.note: Choose ONE matched two-course sequence (8 units): Business Analytics & Econometrics = ECON 1 + ECON 3; Machine Learning & AI = COGS 14A + COGS 14B; Science = BILD 1 + BILD 3; Social Sciences I = (POLI 5 or POLI 5D or ECON 5) + (POLI 30 or POLI 30D); Social Sciences II = SOCI 60 + USP 4. Courses must come from the same sequence.

buckets.label: Exploratory data analysis (MATH 189 or DSC 152)
buckets.note: Choose one. Corrected: DSC 152 added as an equivalent alternative per the HDSI major requirements page.

buckets.label: Senior capstone project
buckets.note: Both required (8 units), taken as a two-quarter sequence.

buckets.label: Upper-division electives
buckets.note: 20 units from approved upper-division courses. Includes any upper-division DSC course not used for core (DSC 100-196, excluding DSC 197/198/199) plus the listed cross-department options, corroborated against the HDSI major-requirements elective tracks (Science, Social Sciences, Business Analytics/Econometrics, Machine Learning/AI). Up to 8 units may be petitioned from other upper-division courses aligned with the student's subject domain. All prerequisites must be met.
